name: Fletcher
configuration: Early round-bridge Fletcher, July 1942-inspired fit; original reference-led reconstruction, revision 2

accuracy.exterior: Original early-war Fletcher-class interpretation. Principal dimensions and weapon counts sourced; hull sections, fittings and exact refit arrangement are approximate.
accuracy.internals: Provisional machinery, magazines, ready-service and flooding envelopes; not surveyed watertight subdivisions.
accuracy.weapons: Five articulated 127 mm guns; two trainable quintuple Mk 15 mounts with ten total rounds; two racks and six K-guns with 28 charges. Shallow 10 m blast, damage, reloads and arcs are gameplay tuning.

structuralPlating.note: Estimated structural steel for gameplay collision and inspection; not a verified armor schedule.
